scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check .
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter frontend lint && pnpm run lint:backend
scripts.format:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff format .
scripts.format: pnpm --filter frontend format && pnpm run format:backend
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && uv run python scripts/reset_environment.py
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && uv run pyinstaller --clean locus-backend.spec
scripts.build:backend:linux: cd backend && rm -rf build dist && uv run pyinstaller --name locus-backend --onefile --collect-submodules app --add-data "bin:bin" --add-data "app/modules/analytics/models:app/modules/analytics/models" run.py
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:backend && npx electron-builder
